derivation.candidate_canvas: tracked v21 foundation-v19-canonical RGB bytes outside the exact v20 eight-body union; full-canvas Lab roundtrip bytes are never retained there

coverage_anchors.definition: exact support geometry, never a measured candidate gate
coverage_anchors.bodies_1_through_7: the corresponding exact nonzero indexed supports in the v19 body control; each must be byte-identical to its v20 support
coverage_anchors.body_8: the value-255 v20 replacement support only; the detached v19 pill support is never an output support or a statistical donor

v19_statistical_authority.single_frozen_source: one byte-closed v19 replay result; quantized contour_field supplies scalar PSD/CDF and the same replay supplies Lab medians
v19_statistical_authority.body_medians: three-element [L,a,b] componentwise Q16.16 Lab medians from reconstructed v19 bodies 1-7 on their exact coverage anchors
v19_statistical_authority.body_signal: quantized v19 contour_field on one body's support with outside-support values zero; no final RGB or spatial phase export
forbidden_exports: source paths beyond frozen provenance identifiers

artifact_schema.fixed_point: every median, radial PSD, and quantile value is a non-bool signed-32 Q16.16 decimal JSON integer; Lab medians are within encoded uint8 Lab range; PSD entries are within [0,1], and each PSD is either all-zero or normalized to unity within its fixed 16-bin quantization allowance; quantiles are monotone
artifact_schema.numeric_arrays: flat decimal JSON integer arrays only; no bool, NaN, Infinity, floats, nested arrays, or coordinate-bearing records
artifact_schema.canonical_json: strict UTF-8 JSON with duplicate object keys and non-finite constants rejected; recursively sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, exactly one trailing LF; candidate loader must reproduce these bytes exactly

dev20_coarse_authority.reconstruction: summary-free in-memory dev20 final RGB reconstruction from the tracked v21 renderer primitives and marks parameters; no TEMP PNG and no call to v21 load_replay_inputs, reconstruct, or _validate_search_summary
dev20_coarse_authority.lab_l_u8: OpenCV 4.13.0 RGB uint8 to encoded Lab uint8 channel L with no preconversion or normalization; units are encoded Lab-L byte units, not strict integer luma
dev20_coarse_authority.delta: D20_lab_l_i is body-local int32 encoded Lab-L: lab_l_u8(final dev20 RGB)-lab_l_u8(foundation-v19-canonical) on exact body-i support and zero everywhere else in the deterministic G24 crop
dev20_coarse_authority.coarse_field: separable literal-Q30 G24(D20_lab_l_i Q16.16) with half-sample-symmetric reflect and integer rounding after each pass
dev20_coarse_authority.search_summary_use: SHA-256 provenance only; --check may hash the tracked bytes, but candidate emission never opens or parses the summary
search_summary_ignored_sections: all content including criteria, selected diagnostics, selection rule, parameters, candidate counts, and topology counts

phase_synthesis.statistics_extraction_crop: the separately SHA-bound extractor derives the tight coverage-anchor bounding box and appends exactly 8 synthetic zero pixels on every side (never canvas pixels); no crop coordinates cross the firewall
phase_synthesis.candidate_phase_crop: derive the tight coverage-anchor bounding box from the tracked v20 control and append exactly 96 synthetic zero pixels on every side, equal to the G24 radius, before phase realization and G4/G8/G24 filtering
phase_synthesis.d20_g24_crop: derive the tight coverage-anchor bounding box, expand by the literal G24 radius 96, and clip to canvas
phase_synthesis.source_window: support-only residual, outside-support exact zero; subtract the separable-Hann/support-weighted mean, then multiply by the separable symmetric Hann window; no inpainting
phase_synthesis.fft: NumPy 2.3.5 float64 rfft2/irfft2 with default backward normalization on the deterministic crop; 16 radial bins are min(15,floor(16*hypot(fftfreq(height),rfftfreq(width))/sqrt(0.5)))
phase_synthesis.radial_power: 16 bins; rFFT one-sided Hermitian weights 2 except DC/Nyquist, DC excluded; each bin is normalized by total non-DC weighted power, zero total gives sixteen zeros, then values are quantized signed Q16.16 nearest-even in the firewall artifact
phase_synthesis.phase: phase of PCG64 standard-normal crop noise; source phase is discarded; for each of 16 bins divide PSD_Q16.16/2^16 by that bin's sum of rFFT Hermitian weights (weight 1 for kx=0 and even-width Nyquist column, otherwise 2; DC weight 0), multiply its square root by the real-noise rFFT Hermitian phase, set DC exact zero, then irfft2 once
phase_synthesis.distribution: 17 Type-7 quantile knots at k/16 inclusive from a stable-sorted support residual, quantized signed Q16.16 nearest-even; stable mergesort rank-map synthesized support values through exact rational interpolation of those knots; this is the sole remap and occurs before filtering or factorial gain
phase_synthesis.bodies_1_through_7: each uses only its own v19 median, radial power, and empirical distribution
phase_synthesis.body_8: componentwise lower-middle median of seven three-element Q16.16 medians; per-bin ties-away rounded arithmetic mean of the seven fixed 16-bin PSD_Q16.16 arrays; per-knot ties-away rounded arithmetic mean of the seven fixed 17-knot quantile_Q16.16 arrays; separate phase seed; no v19 body-8 pill statistic is read
phase_synthesis.seed_uint64_rule: unsigned big-endian integer from the first eight bytes of SHA-256(seed_root + ':' + label)
phase_synthesis.candidate_independence: the same frozen eight phase fields are reused for all four factorial candidates; only the two preregistered gains differ
normalization_order: one stable-rank CDF map to X_i Q16

fixed_filters.representation: symmetric separable signed-free integer coefficients divided by 2^30; each literal array sums exactly to 2^30
fixed_filters.application: int64 separable convolution, half-sample-symmetric reflect, same kernel on x/y, nearest-ties-away-from-zero division by 2^30 after horizontal pass and again after vertical pass
fixed_filters.strict_kernel_reuse: G4 and G8 coefficients are literal copies of the strict audit authority identified only by c27b41e6336974c5ce5fe11c86cefc67ed35851650680c33379c3510444884d7; G24 is a new separate literal sigma-24 radius-96 kernel

band_composition.source: one independently phased, distribution-matched v19 statistical surrogate per body
band_composition.luma_numeric_lattice: all equation terms are signed Q16.16 int64; each rational multiplication is nearest-ties-away-from-zero at Q16.16 before addition; additions occur in the written left-to-right order
band_composition.int64_safety: reject INT64_MIN before absolute value; prove multiplication/convolution headroom before every product; reject rounding-bias overflow; perform checked left-to-right additions and fail before wraparound
band_composition.chroma_formula: constant Q16.16 componentwise v19 body median a/b; body 8 uses the componentwise lower-middle median of bodies 1-7

finalization.foundation_realization: after the synthesized full-canvas Lab-to-RGB conversion and v18 lock restoration, every pixel outside the exact union of the eight v20 body supports is reassigned all three tracked foundation-v19-canonical RGB bytes; an assertion proves complete outside-union byte equality
finalization.colorspace: OpenCV 4.13.0 RGB uint8 to Lab uint8 for foundation and D20; synthesized Lab is Q16.16 int64; convert each channel to uint8 by nearest-ties-away-from-zero division by 2^16 then clip to [0,255]; OpenCV 4.13.0 Lab uint8 to RGB uint8
finalization.chroma: no raw v19 chroma pixels; constant per-body firewall median a/b only
finalization.clipping_order: round Q16.16 Lab to signed integer, clip each Lab channel, cast uint8, then one Lab-to-RGB conversion
finalization.restore_rule: the union of all four lock masks is first assigned byte-exact RGB pixels from v18 after RGB conversion; v18 and foundation must already agree byte-exact on locked pixels outside the v20 body union or emission fails, then outside-union foundation restoration preserves both authorities while foundation has final canvas precedence
finalization.png_encoder: tracked v21 manual filter-0 PNG with explicit stored DEFLATE blocks

cli_contract.check: validate this preregistration, runtime, tracked source paths, and source SHA-256 bindings without decoding or reconstructing any raster
cli_contract.emit: requires the explicit --emit flag; requires a separately sealed statistics firewall; constructs and seals all four payloads in memory, records the exact allowed runtime profile id and each PNG payload SHA-256, then exclusively reserves the final directory and creates each fixed file with exclusive-create semantics; performs no audit or metric calculation
cli_contract.compare_seals: --compare-seals LEFT RIGHT is compare-only: read exactly two regular non-symlink canonical seal JSON files, require distinct allowed runtime profile ids, and require byte-identical authority/statistics identities plus the ordered four candidate ids, fixed paths, byte counts, and PNG payload SHA-256 values; it never opens a PNG, emits a candidate, or evaluates a metric
cli_contract.cross_profile_gate: after generation and before any evaluation or audit, seals from every allowed runtime profile actually used must pass pairwise --compare-seals equality; the ordered four deterministic manual-PNG payload hashes are the carrier/output byte-equality evidence, and any disagreement fails closed so no candidate may proceed
cli_contract.seal_serialization: strict UTF-8 JSON with duplicate keys/non-finite constants forbidden, the listed deterministic key order, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False, and exactly one trailing LF
cli_contract.overwrite: cross-platform fail-safe: final directory mkdir is the exclusive publication reservation; any pre-existing final path fails; every candidate and seal uses exclusive creation; partial failure leaves the reserved directory and permanently prevents retry, replacement, or coexistence
